cohort: Pregnant women admitted to the Gynecology Department of Okmeydani Training and Research Hospital between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2019.
finding: Pregnant adolescents, particularly those aged <=16, were significantly more likely to experience prematurity, low birth weight, and small for gestational age infants compared to adult pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly lower in adolescent age groups compared to the adult age group.
gest_age: Gestational age was significantly lower in adolescent age groups compared to the adult age group.
birth_weight: Fetal weight was significantly lower in adolescent age groups compared to the adult age group.
